01

“forgive those who do not expect the days of God”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 45:14).

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on the words of God, Mighty and Majestic:
forgive those who do not expect the days of God [al-Jathiya 14] He says: "who do not care about the favors of God; they do not thank for them and do not recognize them."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ عز وجل:
يَغْفِرُوا لِلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ أَيَّامَ اللَّهِ [الجاثية: 14] يَقُولُ: «لَا يُبَالُونَ نِعَمَ اللَّهِ لَا يَشْكُرُونَهَا، لَا يَعْرِفُونَهَا»

02

“and the judgment and prophethood”

An explanation transmitted from Mālik ibn Dīnār (Q 45:16).

02
Explanation from Mālik ibn Dīnār 02

Mālik ibn Dīnār

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Uqba al-Asamm related to us, from Malik ibn Dinar, who said:
I heard Ikrima say on His words: and the judgment and prophethood [al-Jathiya 16] he said: "The judgment and the intellect."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا عُقْبَةُ الْأَصَمِّ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عِكْرِمَةَ، يَقُولُ فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَالْحُكْمَ وَالنُّبُوَّةَ [الجاثية: 16] قَالَ: «الْحُكْمُ وَاللُّبُّ»
Edition record 373348 · p. 600Link to report ↗
03

“equal will be their living and their dying”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 45:21).

03
Explanation from Mujāhid 03

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
equal will be their living and their dying [al-Jathiya 21] He says: "the believer is a believer in this world and the Hereafter, and the disbeliever is a disbeliever in this world and the Hereafter."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
سَوَاءً مَحْيَاهُمْ وَمَمَاتُهُمْ [الجاثية: 21] يَقُولُ: «الْمُؤْمِنُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ مُؤْمِنٌ، وَالْكَافِرُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ كَافِرٌ»
Edition record 373349 · p. 600Link to report ↗
04

“and nothing destroys us except time [al-dahr]”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 45:24).

04
Explanation from Mujāhid 04

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
and nothing destroys us except time [al-dahr] [al-Jathiya 24] meaning: "except the passage of time."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَمَا يُهْلِكُنَا إِلَّا الدَّهْرُ [الجاثية: 24] ، يَعْنِي: «إِلَّا الزَّمَانُ»
Edition record 373350 · p. 600Link to report ↗
05

“kneeling”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 45:28).

05
Explanation from Mujāhid 05

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
kneeling [al-Jathiya 28] he said: "meaning on their knees, sitting upright."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
جَاثِيَةً [الجاثية: 28] قَالَ: «يَعْنِي عَلَى الرُّكَبِ مُسْتَوْفِزِينَ»
Edition record 373351 · p. 600Link to report ↗
06

“Indeed, We were having transcribed what you used to do”

An explanation transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās (Q 45:29).

06
Explanation from Ibn ʿAbbās 06

Ibn ʿAbbās

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ata ibn al-Sa'ib, from Miqsam, from Ibn Abbas:
Indeed, We were having transcribed what you used to do [al-Jathiya 29] ⦗p. 601⦘ he said: "The recording angels have transcribed from the Mother of the Book what the children of Adam do; a person acts only according to what the angel has transcribed for him from the Mother of the Book."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ، عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ:
إِنَّا كُنَّا نَسْتَنْسِخُ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ [الجاثية: 29] ⦗ص: 601⦘ قَالَ: «نَسْتَنْسِخُ الْحَفَظَةَ مِنْ أُمِّ الْكِتَابِ مَا يَعْمَلُ بَنُو آدَمَ، فَإِنَّمَا يَعْمَلُ الْإِنْسَانُ عَلَى مَا اسْتَنْسَخَ لَهُ الْمَلَكُ مِنْ أُمِّ الْكِتَابِ»
